operations.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm check:deployment-spec && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Follow README.md and RUN-LOCALLY.md: stop the owned runtime, export with rer export, restore into a fresh installation of the same revision with rer import, configure private settings and sign in again. Damaged archives and populated destinations are refused.
